title: Maple Walnut and Pineapple Sundae
changes_from_base: Walnuts soaked overnight in dark maple syrup and crushed ripe pineapple replace the hot fudge and cherry, over banana ice cream.
summary: A stunning sundae pairing toasted walnuts in dark maple syrup with crushed pineapple and whipped cream. Tropical meets classic autumn flavour.

ingredients.item: banana ice cream (or chocolate or coffee)

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Toast 100 g walnut halves and cover with 240 ml dark maple syrup in a lidded container, adding more syrup to cover completely. Refrigerate overnight; keeps for 2 days.

steps.title: Pineapple
steps.text: Mince 330 g very ripe pineapple chunks and crush with a potato masher; if holding, add a little lemon juice and sugar and chill for up to 2 days.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Whip 120 ml double cream to soft peaks and whip in 2 tsp icing sugar.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Spread a thin layer of dark maple syrup in the bottom of each sundae dish.

steps.title: Ice
steps.text: Add 4 scoops of banana, chocolate or coffee ice cream.

steps.title: Walnuts
steps.text: Top with 4 tbsp of the maple walnuts.

steps.title: Pineapple
steps.text: Top with 4 tbsp of the crushed pineapple.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Crown with a generous dollop of whipped cream.

tips: Toast the walnuts before covering with syrup to enhance their flavour.
Refrigerate the maple walnuts overnight to allow the flavours to meld.
Use very ripe pineapple for the sweetest, most intense flavour.
storage: The maple walnuts keep for 2 days in the fridge; the crushed pineapple keeps for up to 2 days when lightly sweetened with lemon juice and sugar.
